sentences.text: Dipak Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 2 September, 2025

Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
 2025:Jhhc:26577
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 A.B.A. No. 5035 of 2025
 ----
Dipak Kumar, aged about 34 years, son of Munu Sah, resident of village - Lawahi Kala, Po - Dandai,
Ps - Dandai, District -
 Garhwa, Jharkhand .... Petitioner
 -- Versus --
 1. The State of Jharkhand
2. Shanti Kumari, Wife of Dipak Kumar, resident of village - Tetuka Khurd, Po - Peska, Ps - Meral,
District - Garhwa, Jharkhand ....

Opposite Parties
----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
---
For the Petitioner :- Mr. Suraj Singh, Advocate :- Mr. Sunil Singh, Advocate For the State :- Mr.
Rakesh Ranjan, Advocate
----
Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as the learned counsel appearing for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No.1547 of 2023 for the alleged offences registered under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 and 34 of Indian Penal Code,
pending in the Court of learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Garhwa.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the husband of the informant and the case has been registered under Section 498A of Indian Penal Code and Section 4 Dipak Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107773549/
1 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Dipak Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that there are general and omnibus allegation against all the family members and 2025:JHHC:26577 further allegation made against the petitioner is that on 4th September, 2023 the petitioner has assaulted the informant.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the State opposes the prayer and submits that the petitioner is the husband and the allegations are there against the petitioner of assault.

5. Considering that the petitioner is the husband and there are general and omnibus allegation against the petitioner and further allegation is made against the petitioner of assault and there is no injury and in that view of the matter, the petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned Court within two weeks and the learned Court shall release the petitioner on such terms and conditions or the sureties as the learned Court may deem fit and proper.
(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Sangam/
